questions.question: In a mock test conducted by a coaching institute, 20 students average scored 75% marks and the remaining 15 students average scored 54% marks. Find the average score.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of students = 20 : 15 = 4 : 3

Difference in average = 75% − 54% = 21%

Net surplus to distribute = 4 × 21% = 84%

Distributed surplus = 84% ÷ (4 + 3) = 12%

Average score = 54% + 12% = 66%

**∴ The correct option is A.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students in Group 1 (n₁) = 20

Average score of Group 1 (A₁) = 75%

Number of students in Group 2 (n₂) = 15

Average score of Group 2 (A₂) = 54%

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 
 20 Students
 75% Marks

• 
 Total Students = 35
 Combined Average = 66%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total marks of Group 1 = 20 × 75 = 1500

⇒ Total marks of Group 2 = 15 × 54 = 810

⇒ Sum of marks for all students = 1500 + 810 = 2310

⇒ Total number of students = 20 + 15 = 35

⇒ Combined Average = 2310 ÷ 35

⇒ Combined Average = 66%

**∴ The correct option is A.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Principle

The combined average of two groups is always closer to the average of the group with more members (larger weight).

Deviation Method

New Average = Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Observations). This simplifies large calculations by focusing on differences from a base value.

Ratio Simplification

When finding averages, the actual number of students can be replaced by their simplest ratio (e.g., using 4 and 3 instead of 20 and 15) to speed up calculations.</p

questions.question: In an election contested by two candidates, one candidate got 25% of the total votes and still lost by 20,000 votes. Find the total number of votes cast? (all votes are valid)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Vote percentage of one candidate = 25%

Votes by which the candidate lost = 20,000

**Formula used:**

Total votes = (Difference in votes / Difference in percentage of votes) × 100

**Calculations:**

Let the total number of votes be 'T'.

One candidate got 25% of total votes.

So, the other candidate got (100 - 25)% = 75% of total votes.

Difference in percentage of votes = 75% - 25% = 50%

This 50% difference corresponds to 20,000 votes.

⇒ 50% of T = 20,000

⇒ (50)/(100) × T = 20,000

⇒ (1)/(2) × T = 20,000

⇒ T = 20,000 × 2

⇒ T = 40,000

**∴ The total number of votes cast is 40,000.**

questions.solution:

Speed of policeman (Sₚ) = 10 kmph

This 2 km is the head start the thief has.

Relative speed of policeman with respect to thief = Sₚ - Sₜ

⇒ Relative speed = 10 kmph - 8 kmph = 2 kmph

Time taken by policeman to catch the thief = Distance to cover / Relative speed

⇒ Time taken = 2 km / 2 kmph

⇒ Time taken = 1 hour

Convert time to minutes: 1 hour = 60 minutes

**∴ The policeman will take 60 minutes to catch the thief.**
